goal_level: L3 BMKG regional station-status closure scan
source_scope: Public regional BMKG station-status and analysis pages, BMKG public-information/service, historical BMKG, and public regulator sources outside the central BMKG station-detail and API surfaces.

source_inputs.role: seeded BMKG regional/public status source routes
22 BMKG station rows from the station-specific status audit

evidence_gate_counts.reader_use: Confirms the seeded public source routes were tested.
A regional BMKG page can carry station-level status text outside the central detail/API surfaces.
Regional analysis pages can name official monitoring sites, but they do not certify target-row status or grade.

evidence_gate_counts.gate: Target station or official site named outside central detail/API
evidence_gate_counts.reader_use: Station/site context helps target source closure, but only explicit recent status text closes current status.
Counts target rows matched to official regional analysis pages without treating them as status or grade evidence.
Counts only exact target rows with explicit ONLINE status and recent source timestamp.
Cadence and service/tariff sources explain access routes but do not certify target stations.
No seeded source exposes a public inspection log for any target row.
No seeded source exposes a calibration certificate or calibration-status record for any target row.
A current-status row alone is not complete grade or station-radius readiness.

station_rows.reader_use: Use as station-specific current-status evidence from an official regional BMKG page. Do not use it as inspection, calibration, certificate, complete-grade, or radius evidence.
station_rows.non_claim: This scan records public BMKG regional, public-information, service, historical, regulator, and regional-analysis context for the 22 BMKG PM2.5 rows. Regional analysis pages can support station or official-site context, but current-status closure still requires an exact target station with explicit status text and a recent timestamp. It does not certify station-specific inspection logs, calibration certificates, complete monitor-grade status, same-station OpenAQ joins, or station-radius coverage.
